value.rationale: The motivating diffusion integrator is spectrally stable for alpha>=1/(2e), yet all-step positivity fails for every stabilization fraction under arbitrarily small edge-weight heterogeneity. The complete iff classification and exact rate crossing specify the structural obstruction. Logarithmic delay explains why finite-step positivity testing can misleadingly suggest robustness. This is a nontrivial threshold motivated by transport nonnegativity of a published method, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
